notes.text: The direct Shemot Rabbah Pekudei passage names Shimon son of Yishmael.
The Yalkut parallel gives separate sayings of Shimon and Yishmael. Compare its exact polarity and preserve Heilprin’s general notice.
The Midrash Rabbah witness attributes the pardon teaching to Shimon son of Yishmael. Yalkut gives Shimon the preceding remark and Yishmael the next one, phrased as pardon for Israel alone.
